Consistently outstanding! I highly recommend MIA’s.
Oct 2026 • Family
First and foremost, the food is excellent!!!
You will be given a menu that is a work of art with photos and descriptions of each dish and symbols for allergens. Staff are warm, welcoming, friendly and professional. It is clear that they intend to do their best to make sure you have an outstanding experience. 
As I have sensitivities to onions and gluten, I needed and received help to order a dinner that was safe for me. That’s when I met Chef Khanh. He came to my table to clarify questions he had about my request. The meal he prepared for me was absolutely delicious! His personal attention extended to asking me to contact the restaurant earlier in the day when I planned to come to the restaurant so he could make certain meals could be properly prepared. I have dined at MIA’s several times and it is consistently excellent in every way. 
My experience with Chef Khanh led me to take the cooking class they offer - if you enjoy cooking and want a first class experience learning to prepare authentic Vietnamese dishes you will be very pleased with the class. Chef Khanh went so far as to personalize the recipes for me!
Thank you Chef Khanh and the staff at MIA’s for your unforgettable care in preparing my exceptionally delicious meals and ensuring I have a warm welcome when I dine with you. 
I will always be grateful for your kindness to me. 
Fond regards,
Lee

Insider tip:
Make a reservation! If you have food sensitivities or allergies contact the restaurant earlier in the day to explain your needs.
